errors.description: hart_cmd_q is a multi-bit value produced in dm_clk and sampled directly in hart_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
resume_pulse_q is a one-cycle dm_clk pulse consumed directly in hart_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
resume_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample hart_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in hart_event_o.
debug_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector debug_mode_q before decoding in hart_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
dm_rst_n is used as data inside hart_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
jtag_snapshot_q combines dm_clk payload state with hart_clk status state in jtag_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
